# date

Published version: `cli/date@0.1.6`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Display dates and times for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/date@0.1.6 [OPTION]... [+FORMAT]
```

## Supported scope

Print the current time or an ISO date/time or @SECONDS value using TZ, the host timezone, or UTC. Fractional seconds accept up to nine digits.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-u` / `--utc` | none | Use UTC. |
| `-d` / `--date` | required | Read an ISO date/time or @SECONDS. |
| `--iso` | required | ISO output: date, hours, minutes, seconds or ns. Default: `date`. |
| `-R` / `--rfc-email` | none | Print an RFC email timestamp. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Argument and exit-status contract

Option values and operands after -- remain literal during alias normalization.

See the [finite diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics).

## Limitations

- Relative date expressions and setting the system clock are unsupported.
- Formats: %Y %y %m %d %e %H %M %S %j %a %A %b %h %B %F %T %R %s %N %z %Z and %%.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/date@0.1.6 -u +%FT%TZ
moonx cli/date@0.1.6 -u -d @0 +%F
```
